title: EffectKit: pooled voxel-lit particles, flash-light pool and a preset effects budget
player_outcome: Dust, chips, sparks and puffs are lit like the world: dark in caves and warm by torches, never glowing white. Busy fights don't hitch, because effects are pooled, pre-warmed at load and scaled down on lower graphics presets.
design: Verified: CombatEffects.Puff (CombatEffects.cs:74-98) allocates a new CpuParticles3D with an unshaded sphere material per death. BlockEffects pools emitters but uses an unlit StandardMaterial3D with a single colour.

New game/Rendering/EffectKit.cs (created in WorldLauncher, injected into effect nodes). Recipes: Chips (boxes, gravity, bounce-free), Dust (soft quads), Sparks (stretched additive), Puff (soft, rising), Splash (droplets), Leaves (slow-falling quads).

EffectKit API: Burst(recipe, position, Color baseColor, int count, float speed, Vector3? dir, float colorVariance). It sets instance voxel_light from LightProbe.Sample at the burst point and uses a ColorRamp between lighter and darker variants.
Pools per recipe are sized by preset. Count = count × EffectsScale; at most 8 bursts started per frame and 600 live particles, with the oldest emitter stolen.
New shaders/particle_lit.gdshader: vertex colour × voxel_light (includes voxel_light.gdshaderinc), optional emission for sparks, particle billboard for quads.

New game/Rendering/FlashLights.cs: an OmniLight pool (count from preset: low 0, medium 2, high 4, ultra 6). Flash(position, color, energy, range, seconds) with linear decay; the oldest light is stolen.
Core GraphicsPreset: add EffectsScale (0.4/0.7/1.0/1.2) and FlashLights. Validate EffectsScale 0–2 and FlashLights 0–16; add the values to data/config/graphics.json.
Pre-warm: at world start, emit one hidden burst per recipe (so the pipeline compiles during load) and pre-create the pools.
Migrate BlockEffects bursts and CombatEffects.Puff (liquid mixing steam, items burning) onto EffectKit, with colour variance.
files_modify: game/Entities/BlockEffects.cs — use EffectKit chips, lit, colour variance
data_changes: data/config/graphics.json: effectsScale low 0.4, medium 0.7, high 1.0, ultra 1.2; flashLights 0/2/4/6
